effect.name: GM Voronoi Crystal
effect.desc: True nearest-cell crystalline mosaic with refracted cell centers, bevel light and seeded irregularity.
effect.shader: vec2 h(vec2 p){return fract(sin(vec2(dot(p,vec2(127.1,311.7)),dot(p,vec2(269.5,183.3)))+seed)*43758.5453);}void main(){vec2 uv=acScreenNorm,p=uv*cells,i=floor(p),f=fract(p);float md=10.0,second=10.0;vec2 nearest=vec2(0);for(int y=-1;y<=1;y++)for(int x=-1;x<=1;x++){vec2 g=vec2(float(x),float(y)),o=mix(vec2(.5),h(i+g),irregularity),r=g+o-f;float d=dot(r,r);if(d<md){second=md;md=d;nearest=r;}else if(d<second)second=d;}float edge=smoothstep(0.0,.08,sqrt(second)-sqrt(md));vec2 sampleUv=uv+nearest/cells*refraction;vec4 src=texture2DCv(inputImg.texture,uv),dst=texture2DCv(inputImg.texture,clamp(sampleUv,0.0,1.0));vec3 spec=.75+.25*cos(vec3(0,2.1,4.2)+atan(nearest.y,nearest.x)*colorSplit);dst.rgb=dst.rgb*spec+edge*bevel;gl_FragColor=mix(src,dst,mixAmount);}
